{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
raw_data['revenue'] = raw_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = raw_data[raw_data['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Drop QA orders
clean_data = raw_data[raw_data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now, count completed orders (status == 'completed')
completed_orders = clean_data[clean_data['status'] == 'completed']
num_completed = len(completed_orders)
print(f"Number of completed orders (not refunded): {num_completed}")"}
